universes.required: U2: the U1 fit is applied to U2 rows, with no refit, so U2 is a true out-of-universe check

trades: gate v1 trade build, rule A skips, the minimum-move filter on D-1 data, then the one-open rule; features for signal D read D-1; entry at the open after D; costs at 1.5x, cost model unverified

protocol.folds: gate folds. Development test folds 2013-14 to 2021-22; 2023-24 is validation
protocol.training: all earlier rows ending before the test fold less a purge of h sessions, less entries within h sessions after each earlier test fold. gate.train_mask is NOT used: it drops every earlier test fold, against its own description. The frozen code is left as it is
protocol.inner_holdout: the last 20% of a training window's signal dates, purged by h, is used to pick the grid point, fit calibration and score the band
protocol.winsorizing: 0.5th and 99.5th percentiles fitted per fold on that fold's training rows; flags, calendar and ranks excepted
protocol.missing: trees: native missing. Linear and sequence: a value missing is 0 after scaling, with a missing flag per feature group. No forward-fill and no use of later rows
protocol.scaling: mean and standard deviation per fold on training rows, linear and sequence only
protocol.acting: the band is chosen once per spec and h: the median across folds of the inner-holdout's best net expectancy, requiring at least 50 distinct signal dates, then frozen for every test fold and validation. It uses later folds' inner holdouts for earlier test folds, inside development only
protocol.calibration: Platt on the inner holdout, development only; applied to test folds. Reliability curve and Brier score reported
protocol.seed_use: stochastic models report per-seed results and act on the mean prediction; a sign change across seeds is reported as unstable

a_elastic_logistic.features: the 112 features addendum 3 lets go forward, limited in each fold to that fold's allowed list
a_elastic_logistic.act: long above 0.5 + band, short below 0.5 - band, on the calibrated probability

a_elastic_linear.target: T2: gross return, winsorized on training rows
a_elastic_linear.features: the 112 features addendum 3 lets go forward, limited in each fold to that fold's allowed list
a_elastic_linear.act: long if the prediction is above band x 1.5x round-trip cost, short if below minus that

monotone.basis: ASSUMPTION written before any fit: slower trend continues. Not measured, and not changed after any result

b_lightgbm.features: the 112 features addendum 3 lets go forward, limited in each fold to that fold's allowed list

c_har_vol.target: T3: log forward realized volatility over h sessions
c_har_vol.model: HAR: least squares on log rv_5, log rv_20, log rv_60
c_har_vol.use: risk scaling only. It gives no direction, so it cannot pass or fail the gate. Reported: QLIKE against garch_h on the same rows

d_temporal_cnn.model: temporal CNN: two dilated 1-D convolutions, kernel 3, dilations 1 and 2, then a linear output
d_temporal_cnn.features: same as a, each session's row for the same symbol; a session with no row is zeros with flags on

e_ensemble.model: equal-weight mean of the calibrated probabilities of a_elastic_logistic, b_lightgbm and d_temporal_cnn

f_rank.target: percentile rank of gross return among stocks on the signal date, at least 20 names
f_rank.features: the 112 features addendum 3 lets go forward, limited in each fold to that fold's allowed list
f_rank.act: per signal date, long the top bucket and short the bottom bucket of the universe's stocks with a prediction; at least 20 names; each leg pays its own cost

trials.definition: each spec x horizon x universe x target
trials.note: a has two targets, so 7 rows for 6 specs. Grid points are not separate trials under this definition; they are reported beside the count. Each validation read adds a trial

item_d.why: the number of forward specs is not known before results, so the strictest level is used until it is

development_pass: items a, d, f and g on pooled development test folds and the 5 development folds: at least 70% of folds positive, none below -X_h, at least 100 distinct signal dates in every fold; U2 same sign; item e report-only
validation_pass: items a, d, e, f and g: item e against the upper range on validation; item g on all 6 folds; at most one read per spec and horizon
forward_registration: at most 3. If more pass validation, the 3 with the highest development lower bound

controls.time_shift: labels moved by 2h sessions per symbol
controls.stale_features: features taken h sessions older, which must destroy any real performance
controls.scope: a_elastic_logistic, b_lightgbm and f_rank at every h, one seed, first grid point; d_temporal_cnn at h = 1 and 3. Each must fail development

report_only: family ablation of b_lightgbm at h = 1, 2, 3
no_rescue: if none pass, the report says no edge found at the stated trial count. No model, feature or horizon is added
